failures.question: 首单在 2017 年上半年的用户，在 2017 年下半年是否再次下单？按月留存率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
-- 2017年上半年首单用户
first_half_2017_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01 00:00:00' 
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM orders o_prev 
        WHERE o_prev.customer_id = o.customer_id 
        AND o_prev.order_purchase_timestamp < o.order_purchase_timestamp
    )
),
-- 2017年下半年这些用户的下单情况
second_half_2017_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01 00:00:00' 
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= '2017-12-31 23:59:59'
    AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM first_half_2017_customers)
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
-- 计算每月留存用户数
monthly_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS retained_customers
    FROM second_half_2017_orders
    GROUP BY month
),
-- 计算每月首单用户总数
total_first_half_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers
    FROM first_half_2017_customers
),
-- 计算留存率
retention_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        m.month,
        m.retained_customers,
        t.total_customers,
        ROUND(m.retained_customers * 100.0 / t.total_customers, 2) AS retention_rate_percent
    FROM monthly_retention m
    CROSS JOIN total_first_half_customers t
)
SELECT 
    month,
    retained_customers,
    total_customers,
    retention_rate_percent
FROM retention_rate
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 6;

failures.question: 2017 年和 2018 年各月 GMV 分别是多少？并计算 2018 年相对 2017 年同月的同比增长率。
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
gmv_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM 
    order_items oi
  JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
  GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
gmv_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM 
    order_items oi
  JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
  GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(g17.month, g18.month) AS month,
  COALESCE(g17.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2017,
  COALESCE(g18.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2018,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(g17.gmv, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ((COALESCE(g18.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(g17.gmv, 0)) / COALESCE(g17.gmv, 0)) * 100
  END AS growth_rate_percentage
FROM 
  gmv_2017 g17
FULL OUTER JOIN 
  gmv_2018 g18 ON g17.month = g18.month
ORDER BY 
  month
LIMIT 12;
